title: Screenshots, approvals and update warnings
summary: Improves screenshot display, remembers task approvals in Plan Mode, and makes mismatched app and extension versions clear.
improved: The desktop Updates page shows active browser extension versions. Known outdated versions stay red when a later check fails.
fixed: Screenshot previews render from image bytes instead of image URLs that AI sites can block. Unreadable image data shows an error.
Approve all for this task now applies to the same command in Plan Mode.
Creation previews explain missing app support, oversized requests and invalid responses instead of showing a JSON parsing error.
notes: Replacing only the EXE does not update an extension loaded from another folder. Use the full update and load the updated extension folder.
Real Studio captures and the reported creation-preview failure were not reproduced on the affected computer.
The Windows app is unsigned and the Mac app is not notarized.

github.summary: ***Screenshots, approvals and updates:*** clearer results and fewer repeated prompts.

sections.title: ✨ What's new
items: The Updates page shows active browser extension versions and warns when the app and extension do not match.

sections.title: 🛠️ What's fixed
items: Screenshot previews can display even when an AI site blocks image URLs; unreadable captures show an error.
Approve all for this task now skips repeats of that command in Plan Mode.
Known outdated versions stay red when a later update check fails.
Creation previews explain missing app support, large requests and invalid replies instead of a JSON parsing error.

sections.title: 🧪 What was checked
items: Automated approval, response and version checks; screenshot display tested with a strict browser image policy.
The affected computer and real Studio captures were not tested live. Updating only the EXE cannot update a separate extension folder.
The Windows app is unsigned and the Mac app is not notarized, as before.
